scope: Twelve Commander preconstructed release-family Scryfall code records for fall 2020 through 2022, sourced to individual Wizards-of-the-Coast announcements, product reveals, or published Commander decklists.
source_policy: Official Wizards pages identify the named Commander preconstructed release products, not the exact Scryfall set code. Code/date and parent links are the independently frozen 2026-10-29 Scryfall set metadata. Decklist pages explicitly warn that dynamically shown card printings are not exact contents/printing displays, so these sources do not certify printing inventories or legality.
